svg.title: occurrences successively: append its creation polynomial and, for each possible contraction to a previous occurrence on the same side, add that covariance times the polynomial for the remaining word. This finite recursion is Wick’s pairing recurrence. Pairing the two resulting polynomials by (GP4) contracts their remaining occurrences across the reflection plane, since ⟨li, lj⟩F = (L∗L)ij. The factorial Q νi! counts the bijections between equal creation occurrences. Induction on word length therefore identifies the reflected Wick moment with this polynomial inner product, including all permitted contractions internal to either half. A finite linear combination of words has reflected norm equal to the nonnegative squared norm of its associated polynomial. Expanding polynomial insertions into monomials proves reflection positivity at arbitrary arity, and smearing preserves it by integration.
